history.body: Hi, we’re looking around Seberang Jaya for a place to buy and Pearl Residences came up. We have a young child and need a separate bedroom for them, so could you tell me about the 3-bedroom layout and the usual monthly costs?

Type A is 900 sq ft, with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The open-plan living, dining and kitchen area keeps the shared space connected, while the layout avoids a long internal corridor. With three bedrooms, your child can have a separate room, and there’s another bedroom for your household’s needs. The monthly maintenance, inclusive of sinking fund, works out to RM162 (900 sq ft × RM0.18). That’s the confirmed maintenance portion; I’ll verify whether there are other recurring charges so I don’t give you an incomplete monthly total.

That does sound promising for us, and the maintenance figure is helpful. Please let me know what other recurring charges apply and whether parking has a separate cost, so we can judge the overall monthly amount.

Good to hear the layout sounds promising for your family. RM162 a month is the confirmed maintenance charge, inclusive of sinking fund. I don’t yet have confirmed details on other recurring charges or whether parking has a separate cost, so I can’t give you a reliable all-in monthly amount. The other-charges check is still pending; I’ll confirm the parking charge separately too.
